content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary objective lacks estimand specification",
      "quote": "To assess whether pralsetinib improves PFS compared with investigator’s choice of SOC platinum-containing anticancer treatment regimens",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is stated but no estimand (population, variable, intercurrent event strategy, summary measure) is defined, which is required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Add an estimand section specifying the intercurrent event handling (e.g., treatment switching, discontinuation) and the summary measure for PFS."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent number of SOC regimens between synopsis and body",
      "quote": "Participants randomized to the chemotherapy arm (Arm B) will receive one of six SOC platinum-containing anticancer treatment regimens",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "1.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis lists only four SOC regimens in the Active Comparator field, but the text states 'one of six SOC' regimens. This discrepancy could confuse sites and regulators.",
      "fix": "Reconcile the number of SOC regimens: either list all six in the synopsis or correct the count to four."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial stopping rules not described",
      "quote": "The Sponsor has decided to prematurely terminate the study due to Blueprint Medicines' decision to discontinue global marketing and development of pralsetinib",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions premature termination but does not provide formal trial stopping rules (e.g., safety, futility, or efficacy stopping criteria) as required by M11 4.3.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including the process for early termination and any pre-specified criteria."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements are vague",
      "quote": "The dose of pralsetinib can be reduced up to three times for management of drug-related toxicities.",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "5.4.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify contraception requirements for participants of childbearing potential, which is a critical safety element for a teratogenic drug like pralsetinib.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception requirements section, including acceptable methods and duration."
    },
    {
      "title": "No definition of childbearing potential",
      "quote": "Participants randomized to pralsetinib (Arm A) or participants originally randomized to Arm B who cross over will receive 400 mg pralsetinib by mouth once a day.",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "5.4.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a definition of childbearing potential, which is essential for determining eligibility and contraception requirements.",
      "fix": "Add a definition of childbearing potential, including criteria for non-childbearing potential (e.g., postmenopausal, surgically sterile)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pharmacokinetics section is thin",
      "quote": "This study will evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of pralsetinib",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "8.5",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions pharmacokinetics as an objective but does not provide details on PK sampling schedule, analytical methods, or PK endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed PK assessment section, including sampling timepoints, bioanalysis, and PK parameters to be estimated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Data sharing statement missing",
      "quote": "COMMITTEES Independent Committees: independent Data Monitoring Committee Other Committees: Not applicable",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "SPIRIT 6",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include a data sharing statement, which is required by SPIRIT 2025 item 6.",
      "fix": "Add a data sharing section describing whether and how de-identified participant data will be shared."
    },
    {
      "title": "Patient and public involvement not described",
      "quote": "Other Committees: Not applicable",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "SPIRIT 11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention any patient and public involvement in the design or conduct of the trial, which is recommended by SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Add a statement on patient and public involvement, or explicitly state that none was undertaken."
    }
  ]
}
